biotools.summary: FragPipe is a comprehensive computational platform for analyzing mass spectrometry-based proteomics data, leveraging MSFragger at its core, and integrated with TMT-Integrator for isobaric quantitative proteomic data analysis. It provides extensive documentation and Docker container options for streamlined workflows.
